do_not_assume: Stop when authorization succeeds through an intentional rule; do not bypass the server check or trust client visibility.
start_with: Confirm the server action checks the current person’s ordinary authorization.
If a child control needs delegated access, confirm the block created and provided a security grant.
Confirm the control injected the current token and included it in the request.
Confirm the endpoint reconstructs the grant and checks the authorization action needed for this operation.
Check whether the one-hour default token lifetime requires renewal.
Stop when authorization succeeds through an intentional rule; do not bypass the server check or trust client visibility. (Creating UI Controls)
branches.title: A Block Action Is Visible But Returns Unauthorized
branches.when: A Block Action Is Visible But Returns Unauthorized

start_with: Reload through an independent read path rather than trusting the action’s success response.
Compare the submitted JSON contract with the server action’s accepted model.
Check server-side normalization, defaults, omitted properties, and fields ignored by the save handler.
For a generated detail block, inspect the saveable-property list for both missing intended fields and UI-only fields that should have been removed.
Confirm the action reloaded and authorized the intended entity.

If the behavior depends on installed schema or configuration, perform a bounded live readback. The independent-readback practice is a reviewed community pattern, not a universal guarantee about every block action. (Creating Detail Blocks, Creating Blocks)
branches.title: A Save Reports Success But The Intended Values Do Not Persist
branches.when: A Save Reports Success But The Intended Values Do Not Persist

start_with: Confirm the Grid’s key field names a property that uniquely identifies each row.
Confirm every row includes that property.
Confirm the action handler expects the same key representation.
For `PersonColumn`, confirm the server used `AddPersonField()`.
For Person default actions outside `RockListBlockType`, confirm the grid definition uses an IdKey or GUID and that the required entity-set and communication actions exist. (Grid, Grids, PersonColumn)

branches.when: A Grid Action Targets The Wrong Row Or Has No Row Key

start_with: Measure or inspect the total row count, not only the configured page size.
Confirm whether the complete result set is being transferred to the browser.
Reduce or constrain the server result set if the business requirement permits.
Reassess attribute payloads and other per-row data.
Stop when the initial transfer and browser work are acceptable; changing only client page size does not reduce the payload. (Grids)

start_with: Determine whether the value is an ordinary variable.

start_with: Compare the public display and public edit representations.
Pass representative values from both forms through `getTextValue` and related formatting methods.
Update those methods to handle either representation.
Confirm the conversion back to the private stored representation.
Recheck public configuration-key compatibility before changing the contract. (Converting Core Field Types, Creating Field Types)

start_with: Confirm the failing source is an older `.ts` component rather than a newer `.obs` file.
Inspect adjacent template attributes for missing whitespace.
Correct the attribute separation and rebuild.
If the error remains, treat the numeric code as insufficient evidence for another diagnosis. (Misc Notes)
